engine_gap.behavior: Materialized draft workflow packages (44 packages, 182 stage directories) are this run's principal deliverable, written under `.sergeant/drafts/workflows/` -- per-run content that sits outside any stage's own `output/` directory. The D9 disposition/finalize mechanism (`docs/icm/convention.md` §1a) only governs a stage's own `output/`; it has no lower-rung way to assign a disposition to, or bring under `finalize.py`'s reach, per-run content materialized elsewhere in the worktree. The concrete, independently-recorded symptom: `60-draft`'s own draft-package-template.md never mentions 'finalize' (there is no real finalize mechanism it could truthfully describe for draft-tier content), so every one of the 44 generated closing-stage `CONTEXT.md` files omits finalize-step language, which `70-lint`'s structural validator then flags as the identical `[S12]` substantive defect on all 44 candidates -- one root gap surfacing twice, in two stages' own outputs, neither of which has the authority to fix it.
lower_rungs_attempted: stage (name a materialize/finalize checkpoint as each candidate's own closing stage)
stage-context (add finalize guidance as prose inside the closing stage's CONTEXT.md)
helper (a deterministic finalize script referenced by the closing stage)

why_each_fails.stage: Naming a closing stage does not by itself give the runtime anything to interpret as 'finalize' for draft-tier content -- the D9 mechanism the checkpoint would need to hook into still only reads a stage's own output/ directory, and a draft package has none of its own that the engine disposes.
why_each_fails.stage-context: Prose in the closing stage's CONTEXT.md can describe an intended finalize action, but nothing lower-rung executes or verifies it -- it would satisfy the validator's bare case-insensitive substring check for the word 'finalize' without adding any real, checkable behavior, which is exactly the mechanical-looking-fix-on-a-substantive-defect that 70-lint's own method document instructs against applying.
why_each_fails.helper: A deterministic helper script could run at the closing stage, but it would have no existing per-run disposition target to act on -- draft packages have no output/ of their own to publish or dispose, so the helper would have to invent a disposition mechanism for content outside output/, which is precisely the durable fact no stage or helper in this grammar is currently given authority to own.

engine_gap.minimum_runtime_capability_required: A D9-equivalent disposition/finalize mechanism that can govern per-run content materialized outside any single stage's own `output/` directory -- e.g. a workflow-level (not stage-level) disposition target that a finalize mechanism can apply to an entire drafted-package tree as a unit, not just one stage's output/.
engine_gap.observable_acceptance_test: A future run's `60-draft`-equivalent stage materializes N candidate packages outside any stage's own output/; running the workflow's finalize mechanism against that run assigns each package a recorded disposition (e.g. promote/discard), and `70-lint`'s `[S12]` check no longer fires against any of them -- without any candidate's closing-stage CONTEXT.md needing invented finalize prose merely to satisfy a bare substring check.
